0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-2, 8th in the West and 2 games back in the Pacific) host the 3-0 Lakers, who sit 1st in the Pacific and are on a three-game winning streak, while the Clippers have lost two straight, going 1-0 at home and 0-2 on the road. The 2026-27 season series is tied in the Clippers' favor's opposite direction: they trail 0-1 after a 125-117 loss in Los Angeles, and the 2025-26 series was split 2-2. Clippers players ruled out are Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Lakers players ruled out are Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain).
